title: Text: DET Rick Anderson ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Are the coaches under contract for next year? I’m almost positive they were 2-year contracts....Not for use, just my info. ...

Basically, somewhere down the line I’m gonna write about how Gardy has 1 year left after this year. I remember him saying he wouldn’t talk about an extension until you guys were taken care of first, so I’m trying to get my ducks in a row to get the ball moving on that.
Again - just want to be extra careful, given recent situations - this is not info I’m putting out there. I know I’ve ripped Al and the front office, but I feel strongly about having your guys’ back.

I’m sorry for all the crap that’s been heaped on you, you’re just doing your job! All our coaches contracts are up this year. Gardy has always made sure his coaches are taken care of before he moves on with his. He’s a class act. You’re doing a fine job don’t let one incident get you. See you around
I know. And thank you, I appreciate itX
